headline: Seigler carries the load as Boston takes the series opener
morning_brew: That is exactly the type of win we needed to get back on track after the streak came to a close. Anthony Seigler was absolutely locked in at the plate, racking up four hits and driving in a pair to give us the breathing room we needed. Patrick Sandoval gave us a solid start, and while the bullpen had to work to close it out, Aroldis Chapman slammed the door shut in the ninth. It was a complete team effort that keeps our heads above water as we look to build some momentum against Toronto.

Watching this lineup execute with runners on base was a welcome change of pace from the absolute disaster we witnessed the last few days. We have been waiting for someone to step up and anchor the offense, and seeing Seigler deliver in such a big way is exactly what the doctor ordered. The Blue Jays are hanging around the bottom of the division, but that doesn't make the win any less satisfying. Every time we take care of business at Fenway, it feels like we are finally finding our rhythm again.

My neighbor Rick is still busy with his latest umpire conspiracy dossier, but even he had to admit that the calls went our way for once. We have a day game coming up later this afternoon, and it is crucial we keep the intensity high. If we can carry this energy into the next few matchups, we might just find ourselves in a better spot when the trade deadline dust settles. Let's keep the foot on the gas and stack another win before we head out to California.
